credits.body: Mapping: Google Maps, loaded only after your agreement. Audience measurement: Vercel Web Analytics, without cookies.

principle.title: The principle
principle.body: This site collects the minimum. No personal data travels in page addresses, no advertising cookie is set, and no third party service loads before you explicitly agree.

booking.title: Your booking
booking.body: When you book, your details are recorded in our database so that the dates can be held and your stay prepared: name, email address, phone if you give one, stay dates, number of guests and message. They are also emailed to you and to the owner. These details are used only to manage your stay. They are never sold and never used for marketing. They are kept for the length of the stay, then for at most three years after the last contact. The public calendar sent to Airbnb and Booking contains unavailable dates only, never your name nor anything else about you.

analytics.title: Audience measurement
analytics.body: We use Vercel Web Analytics, which measures traffic without cookies and without an identifier that would recognise you from one visit to the next. We know how many people saw a page and which booking buttons were clicked, never who you are.

map.title: The map
map.body: The map in the "Where you will be staying" section is provided by Google Maps and loads as soon as the page opens. Google therefore receives your IP address and may set cookies under its own rules, without any action from you. If you would rather avoid that, the full address is written out next to the map and you can look it up in the mapping application of your choice.

hosting.title: Hosting and logs
hosting.body: The site is hosted by Vercel, which keeps technical connection logs to run and secure the service. The booking database is hosted by Supabase, in Ireland. Emails are sent through Resend, a transactional email service.

reviews.title: Reviews and profile photos
reviews.body: Reviews are shown with the first name only. Profile photos are hosted on this site and are not loaded from a third party.

what-to-do.answer: At Les Sablettes almost everything sits within a few minutes on foot. The sandy beach is 70 metres from the studio, one minute through the seaside park, and you reach it without crossing a road. The park itself runs along the water across the whole bay: children watch the turtles and the birds, families walk there in the evening. Opposite the residence, the shuttle boat jetty leads to Toulon and to the islands. The bakery, the shops and the seafront restaurants are a few steps away. This is why most guests park the car on the first day and do not touch it again until they leave.

beach.title: The beach, one minute through the park
beach.body: One of the finest sandy beaches in the Var, and the shortest way there from the studio goes through the park rather than along the road. That detail matters with children or full arms: there is no roadway to cross between the building and the sand.

park.title: The seaside park
park.body: It starts at the foot of the building and follows the sea. There are turtles on their rock, birds, palm trees and the Maison Pouillon. It is the way to the beach, and a walk in its own right, in the shade, when the sand gets too hot.

water.title: The sea, beyond the beach
water.body: The bay lends itself to water sports, and the jetty opposite the residence opens onto the rest of the roadstead: Toulon on one side, the islands on the other. A day at sea therefore starts two minutes from the door, with no driving and no second car park.

table.title: Where to eat
table.body: Bakery, shops and restaurants are a few steps away, on the seafront and around it. The terraces look onto the beach, and several guests describe walking there in the evening and walking back, which is as good a definition of a car-free holiday as any.

what-to-do.closing: A 3-star studio, 33 m2, up to 4 guests.

boat-to-toulon.answer: The shuttle boat jetty is opposite the residence, two minutes on foot: you cross the street and you are at the quay. From there the bay shuttles run to Toulon, along with the connections to the islands, Porquerolles included. This is why a car is not needed to visit the area from Les Sablettes: the centre of Toulon, its harbour and its markets are reached by sea, with no traffic and no parking to find on arrival. Timetables and fares change with the season and with the line, and are worth checking with the metropolitan transport network before setting off.

jetty.title: The quay is opposite
jetty.body: It is the first thing guests notice: the quay for Toulon is on the other side of the street. Two minutes on foot from the studio door, with no detour and no car to move.

toulon.title: Toulon by sea
toulon.body: Crossing the roadstead is an ordinary public transport journey, and also the finest way to arrive in Toulon. You land at the harbour, at the foot of the town centre and its markets. Several guests have gone for the day, one of them for the Christmas market in December.

islands.title: The islands
islands.body: Connections to the islands, Porquerolles included, leave from the same bay. Check the line, the season and the return time before you go: the service in August is not the service in January.

practical.title: What to check before you go
practical.body: Timetables, fares and which lines are running depend on the season and belong to the metropolitan transport network, not to the flat. This site does not copy them, so as not to display something out of date: check them on the morning itself, and Corine is happy to answer the question during your stay.

boat-to-toulon.closing: The studio is two minutes from the jetty.

car-free.answer: Everything is walkable from the studio. The beach is 70 metres away, one minute through the park and without crossing a road. The jetty for Toulon and the islands is opposite the residence, two minutes away. The bakery, the shops and the restaurants are a few steps away, and there is a bus stop in front of the building. Parking on site is free, which means you can arrive by car, park it on the first day and leave it there until you go. That is what most guests describe: they came by car, then stopped using it.

arrive.title: Arrive, then forget the car
arrive.body: Parking at the residence is free. So the car is what brings you here, and then it waits. That is the difference between a well placed flat and a flat you drive away from every morning.

daily.title: Daily life on foot
daily.body: The beach through the park, the bakery and the shops a few steps away, the seafront restaurants in the evening. None of it asks you to drive or to park a second time.

further.title: Going further without driving
further.body: The shuttle boat opposite the residence opens up the bay: Toulon, and the islands. There is a bus stop in front of the building. Enough to spend a whole week without taking the wheel again.

car.title: When the car still helps
car.body: For the hinterland and the villages of the Var, it earns its place. The studio is not built to do without one at all costs: it is built so that it becomes optional once you have arrived.
